item.title: refactor(ui): remove local-only chat message hide feature (#120681)
item.summary: refactor(ui): remove local-only chat message hide feature (#120681) Remove the localStorage-backed per-browser hide action ("Hide in this browser only") so the transcript mirrors agent context. The action was un-undoable because restore() had no UI path. Stale openclaw:deleted:* localStorage keys become inert.
